verdict.rationale: Azure runs its own public status page (azure.status.microsoft) that reports active events, offers outage notifications, and points to Azure Service Health, so a first-party public health surface exists. A community report from a real outage says the page stayed green and linked to a portal that was itself down, which weakens the 'owned in public' aspect but does not show the page doesn't exist. Missing for 10: evidence of per-service incident history, published post-incident reviews/RCAs, independent corroboration that the page accurately reflects outages.

support.subject: As an operations lead, outages are owned in public — a real status/health surface with per-service history and post-incident reports

citations.quote: Get notified of outages that impact you
There are currently no active events. Use Azure Service Health to view other issues that may be impacting your services.
